江源在京城过得也不怎么好，他本就是个赌徒，当年江晚的那些财产，早就被他败得差不多了，这次来到京城，他以为自己会成为有钱人，谁知道碰了一鼻子的灰。

郁闷之下，又开始赌。

仅剩的积蓄也被败光，江母气得差点和他打起来。

就在两人撕逼的时候，酒店的人竟然让他们收拾东西走人。

两人立即联手对外，不愿意离开，他们可是知道他们现在住的这个地方，一个晚上一万呢。

前前后后加起来，他们竟然在这里住了一个月，就是三十万。

酒店的人可不管他们怎么叫嚣，直接叫来保安将他们扔了出去。

面对强硬的保安，江源只能灰溜溜的走了，嘴里却不断的咒骂时笙。

时笙得知这个消息的时候，只是嗤笑了一声，让他们住那么好的地方可不是白住的，接下来他们还愿意回到那个小城市去吗？

答案肯定是不会的。

江真真手上还有点钱，就租了个房子让江源和江母住。

江源每天都去漫天娱乐找时笙，奈何根本见不到人，江源赌瘾越来越大，江真真拿回来一点钱，都被他拿去赌了，最后甚至是逼迫江真真去卖。

江母和江源厮打了起来，在被江源打了几次后，受不了，收拾东西跑了。

没了江母，江源越发的不顾忌，最后赌输了，竟然把江真真卖了，自己却跑了。

两年后，时笙拿到影后桂冠，之后就宣布退出娱乐圈，丸子粉纷纷表示不能接受。

但是在看到自家小丸子依旧丧心病狂的炫‘夫’后，他们就淡定了，就算小丸子不混娱乐圈了，她依然是他们的小丸子。

五年后，时笙给了陆老爷子十亿美金，然后由陆老爷子给陆清韵，陆清韵在转手给时笙。

瞬间完成的任务的时笙，当场就要和陆清韵离婚。

陆清韵当时是懵逼的，完全不懂自家媳妇的套路，这是自己花钱买自己自由？

有个有钱媳妇，真的亚历山大。

要不是陆老爷子拦着，恐怕真的要应了一些粉丝的话。

嫁入豪门的多，豪门离婚的也多。

虽然婚没离成，时笙却也不在和陆清韵待一块，开始满世界的乱跑。

丸子粉们发现他们家小丸子不炫‘夫’了，开始挖坑了。

从一个娱乐巨星，转行当了作者，名气竟然还不错，圈了一波小说粉。

唯一不好的就是，小丸子的小说总是神结局，神转折，要不就直接太监了。

可是他们还是喜欢小丸子啊！

每次小丸子一开坑，他们就一波接一波的排着队往下跳。

这是病，得治！！

Jiang Yuan's life in the capital was not very good. He was a gambler. Jiang Wan's property back then had been almost wiped out by him. When he came to the capital this time, he thought he would become a rich man, but he was in trouble.

Depressed, I started gambling again.

All her remaining savings were wiped out, and Jiang's mother was so angry that she almost started a fight with him.

Just as the two were arguing, the people in the hotel asked them to pack their things and leave.

The two immediately joined forces and were unwilling to leave. They knew that the place they lived in now cost ten thousand a night.

All in all, they lived here for a month, which was 300,000 yuan.

The people in the hotel didn't care how they yelled, they just called the security guards and threw them out.

Facing the tough security, Jiang Yuan could only walk away in despair, but kept cursing Shi Sheng.

When Shi Sheng learned the news, he just sneered. They were not allowed to live in such a good place for nothing. Will they still be willing to return to that small city in the future?

The answer is definitely no.

Jiang Zhenzhen still had some money on hand, so he rented a house for Jiang Yuan and Jiang's mother to live in.

Jiang Yuan went to Mantian Entertainment to look for Shi Sheng every day, but he couldn't see anyone at all. Jiang Yuan's gambling addiction became more and more serious. Jiang Zhenzhen took back some money, but he used it to gamble. In the end, he even forced Jiang Zhenzhen to sell it.

Jiang's mother and Jiang Yuan started fighting. After being beaten several times by Jiang Yuan, she couldn't stand it anymore, so she packed up her things and ran away.

Without Jiang's mother, Jiang Yuan became more and more careless. In the end, he lost the bet and actually sold Jiang Zhenzhen and ran away himself.

Two years later, Shi Sheng won the Best Actress crown, and then announced her retirement from the entertainment industry. Fans of Wanzi expressed that they could not accept it.

But after seeing their little ball's still crazy husband, they calmed down. Even if her little ball no longer joins the entertainment industry, she is still their little ball.

Five years later, Shi Sheng gave Mr. Lu one billion US dollars, and then Mr. Lu gave it to Lu Qingyun, who then transferred it to Shi Sheng.

Shi Sheng, who completed the task in an instant, wanted to divorce Lu Qingyun on the spot.

Lu Qingyun was confused at the time and didn't understand her wife's tricks at all. Was she spending money to buy her freedom?

There is a rich wife, really Alexander.

If Mr. Lu hadn't stopped him, I might have really complied with some fans' words.

There are many people who marry into wealthy families, and there are also many people who get divorced from wealthy families.

Although the marriage was not divorced, Shi Sheng no longer stayed with Lu Qingyun and started running around the world.

The meatball fans realized that their little meatballs no longer showed off their husbands, so they began to dig holes.

From an entertainment superstar, he turned into an author. His fame turned out to be quite good, and he attracted a wave of novel fans.

The only bad thing is that Maruko-chan's novels always have a magical ending, a magical twist, or just become a eunuch.

But they still like small balls!

Every time Xiaowanzi opened a pit, they would line up to jump down one after another.

This is a disease and must be cured!!
